Package com.hkust.marketplace.controllers

package com.hkust.marketplace.controllers
Shared JavaFX screen controllers and reusable UI components for the buyer, seller, and administrator portals, delegating persistence and business rules to the service layer.

    com.hkust.marketplace
    JavaFX entry point and application bootstrap for the MySQL-backed HKUST Marketplace.

    JavaFX controllers for the administrator login and dashboard screens, including listing review, user and listing management, deal reporting, seller-rating moderation, and profile editing backed by MySQL services.

    JavaFX controllers for the buyer portal, covering registration, marketplace browsing, proposals and deals, history, chat, reviews, notifications, and profile management.
    com.hkust.marketplace.controllers.seller
    JavaFX controllers for the seller portal, covering registration, listing creation and management, incoming offers, chat, sales statistics, reviews, notifications, and profile management.
    com.hkust.marketplace.models
    Domain models and enums for users, listings, deals, chats, reviews, and notifications, mapped to MySQL rows and shared by the JavaFX controllers and service layer.
    com.hkust.marketplace.repositories
    JDBC repositories for MySQL persistence and queries over users, listings, deals, chats, reviews, and notifications, including transaction, locking, and soft-delete semantics.

    Business services for authentication, accounts, listings, deals, chat, reviews, and notifications, enforcing authorization, validation, transactions, and side effects over the MySQL repositories.

    JUnit 5 integration and JavaFX controller test suites for the admin and seller portal requirements, including MySQL-backed workflow and UI verification.
